# Laravel Undocumented Features
> A curated list of Laravel features that are not (or barely) documented in the official Laravel docs.

## Docs

- /: A curated list of Laravel features that are not (or barely) documented in the official Laravel docs.
- /features/eloquent/withAggregate: Fetch a single column from a relationship as a subselect without loading the full model
- /features/eloquent/setRelation: Inject a relation value into a model instance without extra SQL
